# carbon/hydrogen stay compounds despite generic-sounding names: ChEBI has no
# single-word entry for "carbon tetrachloride" or "hydrogen peroxide" (multi-
# word names are dropped, see lexicon.py), so the standalone token is the only
# way this lexicon catches CCl4 liver-injury and H2O2 oxidative-stress
# treatments, two of the most common real perturbations in this corpus.
# arginine matches a real "Arginine Inhibition" treatment.
# honey/ginkgo: found via title-tokenization audit, not sample treatment
# values -- both were literally the study's organism, not a perturbation
# ("Ginkgo biloba" plant scRNA-seq; a "honey bee" pupa atlas). ginkgo IS a
# real (if rare) supplement in other corpora; re-check before reusing this
# platelet* in this corpus's real treatment values means depletion/removal
# (sample prep: "Platelet Depleted", "Platelet Removal"), never a platelet
# paraffin only ever occurs as FFPE (formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded) tissue
# processing, a preparation method, never a compound applied to cells.
# lysine/l-lysine real occurrences are "Histone H3/H4 Lysine N Acetylation"
# (an epigenetic mark spelled out in full), never a lysine treatment.
